## Summary

Reject already-expired HTTP work using its owner clock before request accounting, dispatch, or client checkout, preserving cancellation precedence and in-flight deadline handling.

Make native qualification causal and bounded. A08/A09 loopback fixtures read complete requests and bound cleanup. A09 warms the same default-profile HTTP owner separately before its unchanged short deadlines. PubChem service-context coverage advances its owner clock after the real second request. Diagnostic text stays outside the reserved A13 marker namespace.

Linux Foundation target runners clear certificate environment overrides after Cargo initialization. O06 descriptors match that execution contract. Production TLS and proxy behavior retain their existing contract.

Add the narrowly scoped A09 factory source amendment required by the frozen coverage ledger. It archives the exact previous fixture and reconstructs the current fixture through 152 pinned edits. Existing coverage, captures, manifests, fixture bytes, and other validator routes remain unchanged. Existing mandatory controls reject caller, mode, archive, historical-as-current and reconstruction mutations.

## Validation

Candidate: `d5615ace90b827f31789ccf04c72aaad4516e8f7`, tree `6ddc84cb9e84587c0ba8ab745d8f0576283cb99f`, parent `20b72b11d9be88f6d985ed0fd11827d13d4b5c69`.

- Independent substantive review verified the full PR and this exact three-file successor; no remaining source blocker found.
- Scoped static hooks passed. All-files hooks found only the known unrelated Ruff formatting difference, which was restored exactly. Primary user files remain untouched.
- AST-only graph update passed. All 7,943 source/index rows are captured and verified against the reviewed transition.
- Current-head formatting, strict xtask all-target Clippy, all 113 xtask tests and mandatory rejection controls passed.
- Whole A09 passed its 34 commands: 395 observations, zero mismatches, and the finite source amendment executed. Whole A13 passed all 82 commands. Whole O06 passed. Source/tool/ownership/process and empty temporary-root proofs closed around all six commands.
- Exact-head CI passed: all 21 checks, including full AMD64 and ARM64 Foundation qualification, supply-chain policy, portal coverage, API contract and Docker builds. Independent source review and local qualification remain bound to this same head.

Predecessor `20b72b` completed all 102 workspace runtime targets, 13 doctest targets and ten source-bound isolated children. Its separate F03 gate passed formatting, Clippy, 101 runtime targets, 13 doctest targets, the workspace build and server readiness. Native output, process retirement, report preservation and empty temporary-root proofs are retained. Those are predecessor evidence, not new-head qualification.

The preceding AMD64 CI A09 failure occurred before any gate command because the fixture amendment was missing; this candidate adds that finite identity route. Earlier failed runs and the reviewed captured-child validator correction remain preserved. No benchmark gain or complete rewrite is claimed.

## Rewrite context

[The Rust rewrite case study](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/d5615ace90b827f31789ccf04c72aaad4516e8f7/docs/rust-rewrite/CASE_STUDY.md) defines the migration. Related: #1032 and #897. Broader issue #936 remains open.

AI-assisted contribution reviewed and owned by the contributor.
